title: SLA-aware intake pipeline for hosted multi-action requests (chat + streaming + tools + structured)
creator: Ava Patel
description: Build a deterministic intake and prioritization pipeline for Hosted API feature requests that contain multiple actions (chat + streaming + tool/function calling + structured outputs). The pipeline must surface SLA expectations, required security controls, and contract-sensitive routing signals to enable deterministic TTR (time-to-resolution) and implementation planning for enterprise customers.
background: Multiple enterprise customers have submitted high-touch requests that combine chat, streaming, and tool-calling with structured outputs. These requests often carry explicit SLA requirements or are next to regulated pipelines. Current intake is ad-hoc: PMs and Solutions Eng manually triage, which creates inconsistent prioritization and missed contract obligations. We need a formalized policy and an automated intake flow that encodes SLA, deployment mode (hosted vs dedicated vs private), and cost/latency tradeoffs.
proposed_solution:
1) Add SLA metadata fields to intake form (response time objective, uptime target, required regional residency, encryption/KMS needs, audit log retention).
2) Implement an automated scoring engine that weights signals: customer_tier, SLA_strictness, revenue_at_risk, security_controls_required, engineering_effort_estimate, compat_with_existing_runtime.
3) Integrate scoring output into ticket routing: auto-assign to enterprise PM queue for high SLA / high revenue, to dedicated team for isolation requests, or to backlog for low-impact asks.
4) Create runbook for canary rollout and fallbacks when hosted capacity / model variants are constrained.
5) Expose prioritized list in Console intake dashboard for stakeholders to review and approve.
acceptance_criteria:
- Intake form updated and live for Solutions Eng and Sales (fields validated).
- Scoring engine prototype implemented and attached to new intake tickets.
- Routing rules implemented: high-SLA -> enterprise PM queue; isolation/KMS -> Dedicated/Private evaluation; low-priority -> backlog.
- Two enterprise pilot requests triaged and routed automatically without manual reassignment.
- Documentation and runbook published in Confluence, with on-call contact and escalation path.
impact_assessment: Customer impact: high for enterprise requests with contractual SLAs. Expected to reduce TTR on prioritized enterprise features by ~30% and reduce missed contract SLAs. Engineering will invest initial ~2 sprint equivalent for scoring + routing work. Small UX cost to add extra fields to intake form. Operations: minor increase in ticket automation but reduces ad-hoc PM workload.
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (2 weeks): Add fields to intake form + simple scoring rules (heuristic). Phase 2 (3 weeks): Implement scoring service and routing actions; run integration tests with Linear. Phase 3 (2 weeks): Pilot with 3 enterprise customers (Solutions Eng + Sales). Phase 4 (ongoing): Iterate scoring weights from telemetry and stakeholder feedback; fold into Console intake dashboard release Q4.
